name: Miasma
source:
Miasma is a short visual novel, made for my graduating class, and put on exhibition during our last week of Cegep. Miasma deals with my own experience with mental illness, and how it can affect a person. 

[From [url=https://percydragon.itch.io/miasma] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《瘴气》是一部短篇视觉小说，是为我的毕业班创作的，并在Cegep的最后一周进行了展览。《瘴气》讲述了我自己的精神疾病经历，以及它如何影响一个人。

[来自[url=https://percydragon.itch.io/miasma] itch.io[/url]]
